findings.highlight: what the heck you are you doing!?
findings.evidenceJa: なにしてんのよアンタは
findings.governingReading: She asks what he is doing.
findings.explanation: An extra you breaks Rin’s alarmed question.

findings.highlight: She targeted Tohsaka because she had the most magical energy there.
findings.evidenceJa: あの場ではあいつが一番魔力を持っていたからだろう
findings.governingReading: からだろう marks the highest-energy explanation as Shirou’s inference.
findings.explanation: The suspected reason Rin was targeted becomes definite.

findings.governingReading: Rin carries the fainted protagonist to the church.
findings.explanation: Church is misspelled chruch in both aftermath variants.
